بَلَدٌ مِخْصَابٌ (K) A country, or region, scarcely ever, or never, sterile, barren, unfruitful, or afflicted with dearth or scarcity or drought. (TA.) ―
-b2- And قَوْمٌ مَخَاصِيبُ [A people, or party, scarcely ever, or never, without abundance of herbage &c.]. (TA in art. رتع.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
